title: Unify interactive and replay runs under pinned scorecard versions
description: Interactive sessions and replay studies use the same engine, scorecard revision, cycle/event contract and API-owned SQLite logging. Adding Cyberian Gallery creates a new scorecard edition; old classifier labels/comments remain immutable, request new missing labels for previously reviewed items before unseen items. Replay learning starts from an explicitly recorded empty or selected initial checkpoint, never future labels/examples; process feedback chronologically after prediction. Re-optimize the entire new scorecard from the beginning when requested, with separate per-classifier heads/triggers and one compatible joint decision request. Persist replay input snapshot, parameters, dataset/list revision and lineage. Version comparison distinguishes descriptive latest-200 metrics from matched protected evaluation; switching active edition must be explicit and non-destructive. Acceptance: fake end-to-end tests verify no cycle-one label leakage, retained explanations, restored restart state, missing-label priority and independent original-version metrics; UI exposes active vs inspected version. No automatic paid replay.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented createReplay GraphQL authorization gate and worker replay-next command using the same WorkspaceSession engine. Frozen source trace labels/comments matched to all classifier revisions; no future context at cycle one, no catalog-label duplication, fresh heads/context, parameter ceilings retained. UI offers replay creation source, Step/Run/Pause controls, failure stop. Fake end-to-end test verifies one shared model call, saved explanation and calibration snapshot. Separate run-to-definition mapping prevents run-edition/configuration-revision collision. Remaining: replay progress/live timeline refresh, matched comparison reports, restart/idempotency and browser creation/control acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented read-only matchedRunPreflight and frozen matched_run_evaluation executor. Preflight caps shared protected targets at 200, pins checkpoint/event boundaries, excludes historically learnable targets, and discloses per-class counts. Executor preserves all joint endpoint outputs, restores frozen heads without fitting/promotion, uses training-only checkpoint-bound examples/comments, fixes evaluation datetime across durable cache resumes, and requires a sufficient request ceiling before calls. Fake tests prove cache reuse, source-drift rejection, incomplete-checkpoint rejection, and no-call ceiling rejection. Full Python suite: 656 passed; subsequent focused GraphQL/evaluator check: 17 passed. Remaining: API-owned approved comparison jobs, durable result history, and web comparison controls; no paid evaluation performed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented resumeMatchedComparison authorization, atomic idempotent resume queueing, immutable frozen source retention, separate failed-call retry opt-in, and audit event for renewed authority. Completed/busy runs reject new resume work; identical request IDs return original jobs while altered content rejects. Operating ceiling cannot decrease, and executor now enforces one combined attempt ceiling across both endpoint caches (failed attempts count). Specs prove failed call stays stopped by default; authorized retries exhaust eight attempts without overspending, then ceiling nine completes with one new call; original inputs preserved. Resume UI uses stable submission identity on lost acknowledgements and renewed paid checkbox; controls integrated for failed/interrupted comparison history. Full 664 Python / 73 UI tests and production build passed; focused post-change store tests pass. React skill guided submission identity and disabled-state handling. No real labels or paid calls altered. Browser resume acceptance, macro class-role metrics and tablet/dark verification remain open.
